thread:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty Alert PD-1755555555 fired -> service: runtime-proxy (us-east-1/az2). Symptom: 5xx spike + tail latency, ~75% error rate over 2m. Priority: P1.

oncall-sanjay: acked. i'm on it, paging SRE L2 and platform.

incident-bot: Escalation: Alert auto-escalated to lina-sre after 30s (policy: p1-network).

lina-sre: i'm in. seeing rapid kv-cache evictions and connection timeouts from envoy into runtime-proxy in az2. node-level retransmits up.

maria-eng: no deploys in last 30m from CI. traffic looks normal until az2 nodes start returning 503.

mike-platform: LB metrics -> az2 backend health dropping to 40%. fabric errors on NICs in az2; cca retransmit count x4.

oncall-sanjay: rolling with failover plan alpha: avoid routing to az2, shift traffic to az3, enable cross-region fallback. executing routing change now.

oncall-sanjay: runbook step 2 -> invoking orchestration: `rwdctl routing set-policy --region us-east-1 --avoid az2 --policy fallback-az3`

lina-sre: starting graceful drain of runtime pods in az2 and triggering scale-up in az3. watching for prefix-cache warmup.

maria-eng: reducing per-request batch size to lower mem/kvcache pressure: `runtime-config set --batch-size 1` applied to az3 and remaining az1.

mike-platform: fabric team pushed NIC-level patch to affected hosts; kernel retransmit counters still high but dropping.

status-bot: Status page updated: "Investigating - Degraded service in us-east-1 (az2). We are routing traffic away from affected AZ and working on mitigation."

customer-success-jess: CS getting customer slack pings — sharing the status page link and note: "We're routing traffic around a degraded AZ; no data loss, possible transient 5xx for affected sessions."

lina-sre: quick logs from runtime-proxy showing kv-cache OOMs and connection resets:
```
[2025-07-18T14:12:05Z] runtime-proxy ERROR kv_cache.cpp:245 OOM allocating 128M
[2025-07-18T14:12:06Z] envoy warning upstream reset: connection reset by peer
[2025-07-18T14:12:07Z] runtime-proxy ERROR serve.cpp:412 drop_request 503 code=server_error
```

oncall-sanjay: confirmed failover commands executed. LB now sending ~95% traffic to az3+az1. Observed latency drop on p90 from 2.1s -> 0.34s for routed traffic.

maria-eng: autoscaler triggered +10 instances in az3, kv-cache warmup in progress. prefix caches at ~60% warmed.

lina-sre: holding az2 nodes in quarantine; no restart until infra confirms NIC stable. created infra-ticket INF-8421.

mike-platform: temporary mitigation applied: decreased keepalive timeout to reduce half-open connections and aggressive connection recycle.

oncall-sanjay: customer impact assessment: ~7% of requests during spike got 5xx and were retried by clients; majority auto-recovered after failover. Not seeing customer data corruption.

customer-success-jess: relaying to top 5 affected customers with ETA ~30m for full normalization; offering targeted retry guidance.

status-bot: Status page updated: "Partial service restored - Traffic routed away from affected AZ. Some clients may experience retries. Engineers performing post-failover verification."

lina-sre: doing canary probe across endpoints, running through internal test harness. so far green.

maria-eng: monitoring queues and token consumption, lowering ephemeral cache TTL to reduce memory churn.

oncall-sanjay: marking incident as mitigated at PD. will wait 30m with traffic avoid rule before reintroducing az2. starting incident bridge notes for postmortem.

mike-platform: leaving temporary LB rule for 30m, then controlled rejoin with health-check threshold 3/5 over 10s.

status-bot: Status page update: "Mitigated - Traffic rerouted, engineering verification underway. Incident in monitoring state."

customer-success-jess: customers notified with mitigation summary and workaround.

lina-sre: final check -> error rate back to baseline on remaining routing; fabric retransmits down to normal.

oncall-sanjay: closing PD incident (PD-1755555555) as mitigated. capturing timeline and actions for postmortem. assigning owners: lina-sre (root cause analysis), mike-platform (NIC/fabric remediation), maria-eng (runtime memory tuning).

maria-eng: note for postmortem: consider adding proactive KV cache circuit-breaker and early-oom shedding to prevent cascade under NIC/flap conditions.

oncall-sanjay: thumbs up. filing postmortem ticket MT-1755555555 and scheduling follow-up playbook review. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
